resources.string: Allows ReadMe to read aloud text exposed by other apps or recognized from screen images upon your explicit request. ReadMe never performs gestures, transmits data, or captures screens automatically.
Read text from other apps & screens

ReadMe uses Android's AccessibilityService to read text that another app makes available through Android's accessibility interface, or to capture an image of the current foreground app window for on-device text recognition when you explicitly tap "Read Screen".

• What is accessed: Visible text exposed by the current app, or a screenshot of the foreground app window when you explicitly request Screen Reading.
• Why it is accessed: To recognize and read aloud text or visually rendered content in other apps.
• Control: Reading occurs ONLY after you explicitly tap "Read Current Text" or "Read Screen". ReadMe never captures screens automatically, never monitors screens continuously, and never performs gestures or actions in other apps.
• Privacy & Security: All text and images are processed 100% locally on your device in memory. Screenshots are immediately discarded after text recognition. No images or text are ever stored to disk or uploaded to any server.
• Protected content: Passwords, PINs, and secure windows (such as banking apps) are protected and will not be captured.

When you explicitly tap "Read Screen", ReadMe captures a single snapshot of the current foreground app window using Android's accessibility screenshot capability and performs on-device OCR to read visually rendered text aloud.

• User-initiated only: Capture only runs when you explicitly tap "Read Screen". Never runs automatically.
• On-device processing: Images are processed entirely locally and never uploaded to any server or cloud service.
• Zero permanent storage: The screenshot bitmap is immediately deleted from memory after recognition and is never stored on disk.
• Security protection: Password fields and secure windows (FLAG_SECURE) cannot be captured.
